OCBus.com/August2026 The OC Bus Service Change Improvements summarize adjustments designed to improve service reliability. Updates include schedule adjustments to better connect with school bell schedules, Metrolink trains, and enhance on-time performance across the system. 

## Highlights of This Service Change Route 30 

## All Days: New alignment to Los Cerritos Center via Gridley, Artesia, and Studebaker. There is a new stop added on the new alignment at westbound Artesia, far-side Alora. 

## Route 57 

## All Days: Extension of the short alignment to Cal State Fullerton from State College and Orangethorpe. 

## Route 64 

## All Days: Realignment of the route to the Goldenwest Transportation Center from the Westminster Mall via Bolsa, Goldenwest, McFadden, and Gothard. 

## Route 86 

## Weekdays: New alignment to service Families Forward (8 Thomas, Irvine, CA 92618).

## Routes : 1, 29, 30, 35, 38, 43, 47, 50, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 60, 64, 83, 86, 89, 123, 529, 543. 

## Bus Service Change Improvements – Effective August 9, 2026 Las mejoras en los cambios del servicio de OC Bus resumen los ajustes diseñados para mejorar la confiabilidad del servicio. Las actualizaciones incluyen cambios en los horarios para conectar mejor con los horarios escolares, los trenes de Metrolink y mejorar la puntualidad en todo el sistema.
